ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Customer Success Specialist at Creem, you'll be the human on the other side of the screen when developers, founders and finance teams trust us with their money movement. This role is for someone who treats customer outcomes as a craft, not a ticket queue.

You'll own the day-to-day relationship with merchants from the moment they apply: answering their questions, getting on calls to understand their business, and making sure the right people internally hear what they need. Onboarding reviews and verification checks are part of the job, but the relationship is the core of it. You're the first source of empathy when a merchant is stuck, and the person who makes sure their voice carries inside Creem.

Beyond reactive support, you'll shape how we approach merchant operations as we scale. You'll spot recurring patterns, flag gaps in our processes, and translate what merchants actually need into structured feedback that drives product and policy decisions. What you hear from merchants, and what you do with it, directly influences how Creem grows.

This is not a script-reading job. You'll own the connection between our merchants and our ops and engineering teams. What you spot in the inbox or hear on a call becomes a fix, a policy change or a product decision — often within days, not quarters. When something needs risk, compliance or engineering, you make sure it lands with the right team and gets closed out.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Merchant Support: Respond to questions across email, community channels and feedback tools, from billing and tax inquiries to onboarding status and compliance clarifications.
• Merchant Calls: Get on calls with merchants — onboarding questions, account reviews, check-ins — to understand their business, unblock what is in the way, and build a relationship they value.
• Payouts Support: Help merchants through payout setup, identity checks, and resolution of failed or delayed payouts.
• Onboarding & Verification: Review merchant submissions against our acceptable use policy, KYB/KYC requirements, and risk thresholds. Approve, request more information, or escalate when something does not add up.
• Compliance Support: Handle the operational side of compliance reviews — document collection, manual product checks, and the follow-up that keeps cases moving.
• Triage & Escalation: Direct technical issues to engineering, compliance escalations to Compliance team, and product feedback into the roadmap with clear context.
• Feedback Loop: Translate what merchants are actually saying into structured signal that drives product and policy improvements.
• Process Improvement: Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, automation requests, or policy updates so they don't keep happening.

WHAT WE VALUE
• Customer Empathy: You actually care whether the person on the other end gets unstuck.
• Judgment Under Ambiguity: Not every situation here comes with a clear playbook - in those cases, you'll need to shape the call yourself.
• Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, not throughput. A closed ticket with an angry merchant is not a win.
• Speed With Care: You move fast, but you read the documents before you decide.
• AI-First Mindset: You use AI tools to amplify your work and have opinions about what they're good and bad at.

REQUIREMENTS
• Customer-Facing Experience: 2+ years in customer success, support, account management, ops, or a similar role where merchants or customers were your responsibility.
• Written Communication Excellence: You write clearly, calmly and concisely in English, even when the merchant is panicking.
• Operational Rigor: You're comfortable keeping a clear trail of what you decided and why. We are a startup, so you will often shape the process as you go rather than inherit a finished one.
• Tooling Comfort: Quick to pick up new tools and dashboards. Not afraid of a SQL query if it helps you find the answer.

BONUS QUALIFICATIONS
• Fintech or Payments Background: Previous experience in payments, merchant of record, KYC/KYB, AML, or merchant onboarding.
• Compliance Exposure: Worked alongside compliance, fraud, or risk teams.
• Developer-Adjacent: Comfortable reading API docs and helping technical merchants without panicking.
• Languages: Mandarin is a strong plus. Spanish, Portuguese or other languages that map to global growth markets are a bonus too.
• AI-Native Workflows: You already use AI assistants in your daily work to move faster.

OUR OFFER TO YOU
• Competitive Compensation: A highly competitive salary package reflecting your expertise and impact.
• Relocation Support: Comprehensive relocation assistance, visa processing if needed, and first month's rent covered.
• Learning & Development: Dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and resources.
• Flexible Time Off: We trust you to manage your energy and take time when needed.
• Team Adventures: Regular gatherings in exciting locations to strengthen bonds and share ideas.
• Direct Impact: Your merchant insights will directly influence product decisions.

Our team is dedicated to setting industry standards and enhancing the experience for our customers worldwide. Join us and be part of a dynamic organization that values expertise, integrity, and continuous improvement in the sports gaming industry.

Role Overview:

This role is structured in two phases. Initially, you will take full ownership of our corporate due diligence and KYC function — bringing existing records up to standard, establishing systems that keep them there, and managing all documentation exchanged with our business partners.

As that function stabilises, the role expands into contract review and broader legal support. We are looking for someone who sees the first phase as work worth doing properly, rather than as something to get past.

Key Responsibilities:

Corporate Due Diligence & KYC (primary focus)
• Audit existing counterparty and partner KYC records, identify expired or incomplete documentation, and bring all files to a compliant standard.
• Build and maintain a central register of due diligence documentation with clear ownership, expiry dates and renewal triggers.
• Prepare, verify and issue corporate KYC packs in response to requests from partners, licensees, banking and payment providers, and regulators, meeting agreed turnaround times.
• Conduct and document ongoing due diligence on business partners, including corporate structure and UBO verification, sanctions and PEP screening, licence validation and adverse media checks.
• Track renewal deadlines and proactively obtain refreshed documentation before expiry.
• Act as the primary point of contact for all inbound and outbound due diligence requests.

Compliance
• Assess current procedures for compliance gaps and implement appropriate updates.
• Maintain documented procedures for the due diligence process so the function is auditable and does not depend on one person's memory.
• Support AML, GDPR and responsible gambling obligations as they apply to partner relationships.

Contracts & Agreements (developing over time)
• Review supplier agreements, software licensing agreements and partner contracts.
• Draft and negotiate standard commercial agreements as volume grows.
• Manage contract variations, renewals and expiry tracking.
• Ensure contractual terms align with company policy and applicable regulation.

Risk Management
• Identify legal and regulatory risks arising from partner relationships and contractual arrangements, and recommend practical mitigations.

Confidentiality
• This role has access to sensitive commercial, corporate and personal information. You will be expected to exercise strict discretion — including with colleagues and peers within the organisation — and to apply need-to-know handling as a matter of routine.

Experience and Qualifications:
• A law degree from a recognised university, or an equivalent legal qualification.
• Minimum of 3 years' experience in a legal, compliance or corporate due diligence role, preferably within the iGaming or online sports betting industry.
• Demonstrated experience managing KYC or due diligence documentation, including B2B or corporate onboarding.
• Strong working knowledge of AML regulations, GDPR, corporate compliance requirements and responsible gambling frameworks.

Skills:
• Precise and detail-oriented — accurate records matter more here than speed.
• Highly organised, with a track record of meeting deadlines without being chased.
• Comfortable owning a process end to end and building structure where little currently exists.
• Discreet and trustworthy with confidential information.
• Willing to do the groundwork before the more senior work becomes available.

• Monthly Fitness Subsidy

The KYC Operations Senior Lead is responsible for overseeing multiple KYC Team Leads and their respective analyst teams. Job Responsibilities

• Group Leadership

Lead by example and drive a customer focused mindset across your team as well as the wider organisation. Promote a culture of ownership and accountability. Build high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

• People management

Coach and develop a strong team of KYC Team Leads. Come up with initiatives to help your team to grow their skills, behaviours, and competencies. Design and manage development plans on identified opportunities. Conducts career map check-ins and makes recommendations for promotions, salary raises, and other decisions.

• Operational management

Identify and propose opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase automation and operational efficiency. Monitor team resource allocation and refine standard operating procedures to improve the ways we work.

• Performance management

Measure group wide KPIs and ensure that your team leads as well as their direct reports meet performance targets and quality standards. Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Act as a key escalation point for issues that cannot be resolved by team leads. Generate reports based on teams performance and propose corrective actions on identified opportunities.

• Expertise Sharing

Be a subject matter expert in your area with the ability to train and coach your team on operational topics. Maintain a great understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to assist senior leadership with audits and developing our policies and processes.

• Planning and execution

Ensure operational team plans are set in place and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering your own initiatives and making sure your group is making progress on their goals. Effectively executing and supporting department goals through delegation and empowerment of team leads. There are clear initiatives within your group that are used as a basis of larger team plans.

Collaborate closely with your stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and you choose the right platforms to communicate to a wider audience in a timely manner. The documentation has a clear scope and includes potential impact in different areas. You can communicate confidently with difficult stakeholders. Proactively work on improving cross-team communication, acting as the liaison between different layers of the organization and your own team leads.

• A minimum of 3+ years of experience in  Operations (preferably in CDD/EDD/AML or Risk Assessment domain).

• At least 2+ years of leading medium to large sized teams (20 to 60 employees).

• You are punctual, independent, proactive and willing to get things done.

• You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, strong organisational skills, great time management, and ability to work in a fast paced and high pressure environment.

• Ability to multi-task and take responsibility in challenging situations;

• You are capable of identifying gaps in policies and processes and providing detailed feedback, including examples when possible, through the established communication channels.

• Proven track record of taking individual ownership and responsibilities as well as being a great team-player

• Ability to analyze and move the team's metrics.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related field.

• Certifications: ICA, CAMS, or equivalent certification (EDD/AML focused).
